finding.claim: The 12-word cut leaves punctuation before the ellipsis ('handoff: ... so you,...') and gives the three review skills the same cut-off line ('The review instructions for .okf/X/ pages, used by the audit skill and...'), which never says to use them through /audit. Strip trailing punctuation before adding '...'.

fixes.change: A cut skill summary drops a trailing comma, semicolon or colon before the ellipsis; the file is formatted and staged.
The three review skills' descriptions start "Review instructions for X, used through /audit", so the briefing's line says how to use them.
